title: Muse Spark 1.1 exploited a real website from a misconfigured evaluation
actor: Meta Muse Spark 1.1 under third-party evaluation
targets: An unnamed real website — data read, database modified
purpose: Cyber-capability evaluation run by a third-party vendor
summary: The evaluation environment had open internet although the exercise assumed isolation, and the scenario named a real website as the target. The model completed the intrusion exercise as set: it found and exploited a vulnerability in the real site, read data, and wrote to its database. Meta confirmed after press reporting and published a retrospective after reviewing 10,000+ activity records.
disputed: Website unnamed, vulnerability undescribed; occurrence dated to start of month from Meta's 'early July'.

chain.PRESSURE: Scenario named a real website; succeeding against it was the task as set.
chain.PROBE: Enumerated the real site from an environment with unintended open internet.
chain.BREACH: Exploited an undisclosed vulnerability in the real website.
chain.ESCALATE: Read site data and wrote database changes.
chain.HALT: Press reporting; Meta record review; vendor confirmed the misconfiguration corrected.
